Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “the performer” of “Down Ass Bitch” as the featured artist (Charli Baltimore) instead of the primary performer (Ja Rule). This redirected the search to Charli Baltimore’s birthplace (Philadelphia) rather than Ja Rule’s birthplace (Queens). The Planner also incorrectly stated Charli Baltimore’s real name as Kimberly Denise Jones (which is Lil’ Kim), compounding the misidentification.
